comment:
* Descriptor of the stats collected for a given power component (e.g. CPU, WiFi etc).
     * This descriptor is used for storing PowerStats and can also be used by power models
     * to adjust the algorithm in accordance with the stats available on the device.

variables.name: powerComponentId
variables.comment:
* {@link BatteryConsumer.PowerComponent} (e.g. CPU, WIFI etc) that this snapshot relates
         * to; or a custom power component ID (if the value
         * is >= {@link BatteryConsumer#FIRST_CUSTOM_POWER_COMPONENT_ID}).

variables.name: statsArrayLength
variables.comment: * Stats for the power component, such as the total usage time.

variables.name: stateLabels
variables.comment: * Map of device state codes to their corresponding human-readable labels.

variables.name: stateStatsArrayLength
variables.comment: * Stats for a specific state of the power component, e.g. "mobile radio in the 5G mode"

variables.name: uidStatsArrayLength
variables.comment: * Stats for the usage of this power component by a specific UID (app)

variables.name: extras
variables.comment:
* Extra parameters specific to the power component, e.g. the availability of power
         * monitors.

methods.name: public PowerStatsFormatter getDeviceStatsFormatter()
methods.comment: * Returns a custom formatter for this type of power stats.

methods.name: public PowerStatsFormatter getStateStatsFormatter()
methods.comment: * Returns a custom formatter for this type of power stats, specifically per-state stats.

methods.name: public PowerStatsFormatter getUidStatsFormatter()
methods.comment: * Returns a custom formatter for this type of power stats, specifically per-UID stats.

methods.name: public String getStateLabel(int key)
methods.comment:
* Returns the label associated with the give state key, e.g. "5G-high" for the
         * state of Mobile Radio representing the 5G mode and high signal power.

methods.name: public void writeSummaryToParcel(Parcel parcel)
methods.comment: * Writes the Descriptor into the parcel.

methods.name: public static Descriptor readSummaryFromParcel(Parcel parcel)
methods.comment:
* Reads a Descriptor from the parcel.  If the parcel has an incompatible format,
         * returns null.

methods.name: public void writeXml(TypedXmlSerializer serializer) throws IOException
methods.comment: * Stores contents in an XML doc.

methods.name: public static Descriptor createFromXml(TypedXmlPullParser parser) throws XmlPullParserException, IOException
methods.comment:
* Creates a Descriptor by parsing an XML doc.  The parser is expected to be positioned
         * on or before the opening "descriptor" tag.
